title: Review the initial MDD patient and database plan
proposedRouting: Play the linked patient, inspect the complete rule trace and database-plan comparison, then describe the smallest rule or content change you want.
guidance: Does this initial-depression snapshot ask for the right focused history and workup, rank medication and psychotherapy options sensibly, and score outpatient versus escalated disposition fairly? Note any clinically important omission, overreach, treatment-fit issue, or point effect that felt wrong. The patient and all rules remain medically unreviewed.
resurfacingTrigger: When the linked scenario, MDD policy, investigation catalog, or treatment catalog changes.
